hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/bald-eagle-state-park/stay ('Electric hookups of 30 amps are available at most sites, and some campsites have 50-amp hookups. Some sites have full service hookup, which includes sewer, water, and electricity.') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880133 (40 public sites list 50-amp, 65 list 30-amp; the 40 Full-Hookup sites list water and sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Russell P. Letterman (modern) campground: 114 sites on the booking site (65 Modern Electric, 40 Full-Hookup, 9 Modern Non-Electric), all with paved spurs; DCNR says 94. Rustic area: 34 drive-in sites for camping vehicles (20-40 ft) plus 34 walk-to tent sites. Modern sites list 40 ft; Full-Hookup sites mostly 40-52 ft, a few 57-58 ft and one (M122, White Pine) 73 ft.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/bald-eagle-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880133 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway) + the DCNR stay page ('This rustic area has 34 walk-to sites for tents and 34 sites reserved for camping vehicles'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Flush toilets and warm showers in the modern Russell P. Letterman Campground; the rustic area has non-flush toilets with a sink, drinking water along the road, and its own dump station.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/bald-eagle-state-park/stay ('Flush toilets', 'Warm showers', 'Sanitary dump station'; rustic area: 'Drinking water is available along the campground road. Restrooms have non-flush toilets... A sanitary dump station is available.'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites (modern, full-hookup and rustic) can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/bald-eagle-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880133 (Booking Window for Full-Hookup, Modern Electric, Modern Non-Electric, Rustic Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window; season (second Friday of April to mid-December) already manual. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 40 full-hookup sites, 148 RV-usable sites (114 modern + 34 rustic drive-in) to 73 ft, showers/flush toilets (modern), vault toilets (rustic), drinking water, dump. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs, pull-throughs. Fees left as recorded. Catalog water distances 'Greater/Less than 300 feet' only; stored 'not waterfront' not contradicted.
